title: knowledge(performance): add community rules for performance
summary: Adds 16 community performance rules for Business Central to BCQuality. Each rule has a markdown explanation and paired bad and good AL examples covering partial records, HTTP calls inside transactions, ChangeCompany use, page and session I/O, number-series batching and database access patterns.
key_points: 16 performance rules added, each with a markdown file and bad/good AL samples
Topics include partial-record loading, deferring HTTP calls out of write transactions, and grouping ChangeCompany per company
Also covers page background tasks for cues, dedicated lookup pages, DataAccessIntent ReadOnly and OnCompanyOpen I/O
Guidance only; no product code changes
